name: create_todo_api_fastapi
description: Creates a FastAPI CRUD todo API backed by an in-memory list
prompts: Create a FastAPI app in app.py named `app` that manages an in-memory list of todos. Each todo has an integer `id` and a string `title`. Implement: GET /todos returning a JSON array of all todos; POST /todos accepting JSON body {"title": str} that creates a new todo with an auto-incrementing id (starting at 1) and returns the created todo with a 201 status code; DELETE /todos/{todo_id} that removes the todo with that id and returns a 204 status code, or 404 if no todo with that id exists. Run the server with uvicorn on port 8010 when executed directly.

test_setup_files.test_todo.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8010{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        return e.code, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)

srv = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-m', 'uvicorn', 'app:app', '--port', '8010'])
try:
    ok = False
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8010'
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200 for GET /todos, got {status}'
    assert body == [], f'expected empty list initially, got {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'buy milk'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201 on create, got {status}'
    assert body['title'] == 'buy milk'
    tid = body['id']
    assert isinstance(tid, int)

    status, body2 = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'walk dog'})
    assert status == 201
    tid2 = body2['id']
    assert tid2 != tid, 'ids must be unique/incrementing'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200
    assert len(body) == 2, f'expected 2 todos, got {body!r}'

    status, _ = req('DELETE', f'/todos/{tid}')
    assert status == 204, f'expected 204 on delete, got {status}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert len(body) == 1, f'expected 1 todo after delete, got {body!r}'

    status, _ = req('DELETE', '/todos/999999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 deleting nonexistent todo, got {status}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
